import sqlite3
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("backend/storage/private")
conn=sqlite3.connect("backend/data/app.db")
rows=conn.execute("select id, original_path from photo").fetchall()
conn.close()
ext=Counter(); sizes=[]; missing=[]
for pid, rel in rows:
    p=root/rel
    ext[p.suffix.lower() or "<none>"] += 1
    if p.is_file(): sizes.append((p.stat().st_size,pid,rel))
    else: missing.append((pid,rel))
print("extensions", dict(sorted(ext.items())))
print("missing", len(missing))
print("largest")
for size,pid,rel in sorted(sizes, reverse=True)[:15]: print(size,pid,rel)
